Vukem v0.0.0-test

Usage:
  vukem <command> [flags] [args]

  new <name>              Create a project from the HTMX + SQLite starter
  serve                   Run the app and restart it when Go files change
  build                   Build assets (Vite) and a production binary in bin/
  version                 Print the vukem version
 install
  install:auth            Add login, registration, password reset and email verification
  install:api             Add API tokens, /api/v1 routes, CORS and rate limiting
  install:billing         Add Stripe subscriptions: plans, Checkout, Billing Portal, webhooks
  install:inertia         Turn the HTMX starter into Inertia (--react, --vue or --svelte) with --force
 boost
  boost:install           Add agent guidelines, skills and the vukem-boost MCP server
 key
  key:generate            Write a new APP_KEY to .env
 
  down                    Put the app in maintenance mode (503; --secret or --with-secret to bypass)
  up                      Bring the app out of maintenance mode
 make
  make:controller <Name>  Create a controller
  make:model <Name>       Create a model (with -m, -f, -c)
  make:migration <name>   Create a migration and register it
  make:middleware <Name>  Create an HTTP middleware
  make:request <Name>     Create a validated request struct
  make:command <Name>     Create an app command and register it
  make:provider <Name>    Create a provider and register it
  make:resource <Name>    Create an API resource (JSON transformer) for a model
  make:factory <Name>     Create a model factory (fake data for tests and seeders)
  make:seeder <Name>      Create a seeder and register it
  make:event <Name>       Create an event type
  make:listener <Name>    Create an event listener and register it (--event Name [--async|--queued])
  make:job <Name>         Create a queued job and register its handler
  make:mail <Name>        Create a mailable and its view
  make:policy <Name>      Create an authorization policy and register it
  make:test <Name>        Create a test using the fluent client

Other commands (migrate, route:list, about, your own) run in the app: vukem <command>.
